patch_description: This redesign replaces the long single-proposal annealing loop with a modular active-constraint optimizer. It evaluates batches of geometry-aware proposals for one movable point at a time, focusing computation on triangles currently near the minimum area. Proposal directions combine random exploration with determinant-gradient directions derived from limiting triangles, making late-stage refinement more efficient. The square hull remains fixed for stable unit-area normalization, and caching preserves deterministic repeated calls.
